purpose: Machine-readable morning reconciliation receipt and fast-start manifest for MASTER_ROOT, LEARNING, BOOK, DOCUMENTS and the named PROGRAMMING_WORK_PROGRAM under current program-job/completion/retirement locks.
program_job_rules: Every morning reconciliation reads CURRENT-AUTHORITY and its selected topology, program_job_lock and system_completion_status before interpreting completion or selecting work.
SYSTEM_MASTER, CORE, LEARNING, BOOK and DOCUMENTS remain active/incomplete until explicit product-level completion authority changes their standing.
PROSE is historically complete and terminally retired with no active owner, child/inherited execution, repair, qualification, research, telemetry, successor or claim domain.
BOOK owns any genuinely unfinished integration of preserved completed Prose capability as ordinary Book work and retains canonical Book authority.
LEARNING finishes Learning and integrates upward into SYSTEM_MASTER without crossing BOOK, DOCUMENTS or PROGRAMMING work.
DOCUMENTS finishes document/artifact behavior and integrates upward into SYSTEM_MASTER; it receives no Prose work.
CORE supplies shared Foundation/Spine and System Master integration primitives without taking peer-system or Programming engineering semantics.
While SYSTEM-MASTER-KNOWLEDGE-RECOVERY-001 is selected, CORE prioritizes Programming proving-corpus recovery and then remaining authorized catalog/archive recovery as highest discretionary work.
PROGRAMMING is an incomplete active non-peer work program and does not become a peer without explicit admission.
master_root_rules: MASTER_ROOT is a chat role over SYSTEM_MASTER product-root governance, not a peer system.

MASTER_ROOT reads CORE, LEARNING, BOOK and DOCUMENTS, historical Prose evidence only when needed, named work-program boundaries such as PROGRAMMING, and shared infrastructure without silently taking product authority.
MASTER_ROOT has no active peer-worker Second Shift lane; execution lanes are discovered from the Second Shift registry.
retired_prose_rules: PROSE does not receive a bootstrap packet, active focus role, live owner lookup, repair route, qualification route, research task, telemetry ledger or successor task.
A user request about unfinished integration of preserved completed Prose capability resolves to BOOK and remains Book-owned.
Historical Prose artifacts/receipts remain exact-subject provenance only and cannot transfer PASS to changed Book integration bytes.
Any metadata still labeling PROSE active is STALE_ARCHITECTURE_PENDING_RECONCILIATION and cannot dispatch.
documents_rules: DOCUMENTS is an active incomplete first-class peer system at SYSTEM_MASTER/DOCUMENTS with control ref documents/control-v1.
DOCUMENTS owns DOCX/PDF/PPTX/document artifact mechanics and generic document services and integrates upward into SYSTEM_MASTER.
DOCUMENTS receives no Prose work and may not mutate Book canonical state or take Programming engineering work.
second_shift_rules: Active peer lanes are exactly CORE, LEARNING, BOOK and DOCUMENTS.
Compare topology peer_system_ids to Second Shift owner_files on every reconciliation and require exact coverage.
Machine-resolvable missing coverage may be provisioned only for an already-declared peer; missing coverage never creates a new system and retired systems are never provisioned.
Only one mutation-capable claim may be live per active peer lane.
Telemetry is factual and only for active peer lanes; no new Prose telemetry is created or expected.
programming_rules: PROGRAMMING_WORK_PROGRAM loads CURRENT-AUTHORITY.programming_work_program_lock and CURRENT-AUTHORITY.programming_system_packet before selecting work.

The Programming packet preserves Programming Foundation, capability-ledger, crosscut, closure-repair, programming-core/source-code, CODE-QUAL and Genesis evidence as reusable continuity inputs; do not restart them merely because the chat is new.
Programming-specific software-engineering semantics remain Programming work even when shared Core execution/model/storage/A-01 primitives are consumed.
Programming may prepare explicit System Master integration/admission contracts but has no canonical peer owner path, repair inbox or Second Shift peer lane before topology admission.
Knowledge Recovery supports Programming source/custody/provenance and is highest discretionary System Master work while control 001 is selected, but does not replace Programming engineering.
freshness_rules: The morning manifest is a cache and reconciliation receipt, not authority over later repository movement.
Every chat start re-fetches current main and every relevant live active-owner control head.
A head, job-lock, completion-status or state change after manifest generation is AUTHORITY_DELTA and is reconciled before work.
anti_surprise_rules: Do not ask the user to restate System Master, repository identity, active topology, prior work, archived research, Second Shift history, system job assignments or completion truth when canonical lookup can resolve it.
Do not recreate or reactivate PROSE; unfinished completed-capability integration resolves to BOOK and Documents receives none.
Do not restart completed Programming foundation/capability/assurance work or reduce Programming to Knowledge Recovery; load the Programming work-program lock and packet first.
Do not restart sealed/completed packets because a chat is new, and do not mistake packet completion for whole-system completion.
If durable authority cannot resolve a decision, ask only the smallest exact human/author/private/native/external decision required.
authority_boundary: This manifest accelerates startup and records reconciliation. It does not transfer PASS, owner, canonical-writer, peer-system topology, A-01, human, author, private, blind, native, publication or production authority.
